description: Phase 11 — Real Repository Continuity: clone/fetch, base commit verification, no silent fallback, safe git arguments, push to remote, no npm fallback for VerificationPlan

forbiddenPatterns.workerDirectlyImportsZaiSdk: Worker must use callLLM gateway, not directly import z-ai-web-dev-sdk as the primary path
forbiddenPatterns.guardianDerivesFromTests: Guardian verdict must NOT be derived from test results
forbiddenPatterns.reviewerDerivesFromTests: Reviewer verdict must NOT be derived from test results
forbiddenPatterns.versionPhase5: Version endpoint must not report phase5
forbiddenPatterns.versionPhase8: Version endpoint must not report phase8
forbiddenPatterns.versionPhase10: Version endpoint must not report phase10
forbiddenPatterns.silentBaseCommitFallback: Worker must not silently fall back when baseCommitSha is unavailable
forbiddenPatterns.npmFallbackForVerificationPlan: Worker must not silently fall back to npm when VerificationPlan is missing
forbiddenPatterns.shellInterpolatedGit: Git commands must use argument arrays, not shell-interpolated strings
